title: Perfect Sandwiches
statement: The task is to split a cheese and b sausage slices (a, b up to 100, 10^4 tests) into the most sandwiches, using every slice, where each sandwich has at least one sausage and strictly more cheese than sausage, or report -1. Each sandwich consumes at least one sausage and at least one unit of the cheese surplus a-b, giving min(b, a-b) when a > b.
